svg.title: Async-RBench v11.0 — Coordinated tonal framework with task and event icons
svg.desc: Paired conditions, Main-owned scenario decisions for eight event themes, concurrent subagent timelines with small optional-change pictograms, and separate BTS and DRS scoring. Each event DRS equally blends process score and outcome score; Async DRS averages scored event values. Each reported metric uses an equal macro over eight themes. The lock badge identifies evaluator-private truth and checks used for scoring. BTS and DRS have equal visual emphasis; Linear BTS, Async BTS, and Async DRS remain independent reported metrics. Main agent sends control to subagents. Results enter the evaluator kernel, whose delivery stages start at Check on the right, then Policy and Release lead back to Main agent on the left. Four main arrows and two left-pointing outline arrows in the kernel. Replan groups six themes, and Keep plan groups stale and replayed results. This expected-response grouping is explanatory, not hidden input to the agent.
